results.title: Christmas Charades Printable Game, 24 Acting Cards with Instructions and Team Scorecard
results.description:
Christmas Charades Printable Game, 24 Acting Cards with Instructions and Team Scorecard

Bring festive fun to your gathering with this Christmas Charades printable game. Act out 24 holiday prompts while your team tries to guess before the timer runs out. An easy-to-prepare activity for family Christmas parties, office celebrations and holiday game nights.

WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE
Two printable PDF files:
- A4 (210 x 297 mm): 6 pages.
- US Letter (8.5 x 11 inches): 6 pages.

Both files include the complete color and black-and-white versions.

PAGE GUIDE FOR EACH PDF
- Pages 1-2: 24 color charades cards.
- Page 3: Color How to Play + Team Scorecard.
- Pages 4-5: The same 24 cards in black-and-white.
- Page 6: Black-and-white How to Play + Team Scorecard.

Each card sheet has 12 cards in a 3-column x 4-row layout with dashed cutting guides. The scorecard has space for team names, six turns per team, totals and tiebreak rounds.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Divide into two teams and choose an actor for the first turn.
2. Draw one card and act it out without speaking or making sounds. Your own team has 60 seconds to guess.
3. A correct guess earns 1 point and ends the turn. If time runs out, score 0.
4. Each turn allows one pass. Set that card aside, draw a replacement and keep the timer running.
5. Alternate teams and rotate actors. Play 6 turns per team.
6. The team with the most points wins. If tied, give each team one extra turn and compare scores after both have played. Repeat one turn per team until scores differ.

Set used and passed cards aside. If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle them.

PROMPT EXAMPLES
Wrapping a gift, Building a snowman, Baking cookies, Untangling string lights, Sneaking a cookie, and Building a gingerbread house.

PRINTING & PREPARATION
Choose pages 1-3 for color or pages 4-6 for black-and-white. Print single-sided at Actual Size / 100% on paper or cardstock. Cut along the dashed lines, shuffle the cards and place them face down.

You'll also need scissors, a pen and a 60-second timer.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
All game text is in English. This listing is for digital PDF files only. No physical item will be shipped.

AI Disclosure: This digital product was created using AI tools.
